slides.title: 5 dev stories you missed this week
slides.body: Nov 23–27, 2026. Swipe for the short version.

slides.title: Copilot code review billing is changing
slides.body: From Dec 30, 2026, Copilot code review on Business and Enterprise plans will be billed to the organization by default.
points: Why it matters: AI tools now have real costs
Admins can pick Member to keep billing as is

slides.title: Todoist confirms data breach
slides.body: Stolen credentials led to customer data being taken. TechCrunch reports about 6% of customers were affected.
points: Why it matters: never reuse passwords
Turn on 2FA and rotate shared API tokens

slides.title: Anthropic moved its API from Python to Rust
slides.body: Anthropic says the Rust version uses about 70% less CPU per request. Claude wrote the first core version in about a week.
points: Why it matters: AI speeds up big rewrites
Profile your code before you scale it

slides.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo
slides.body: An open-source Linux runtime that uses eBPF shields to block vulnerable code paths while patches roll out.
points: Why it matters: eBPF is key to Linux security
Great topic for a security project

slides.title: Ladybird browser alpha is out
slides.body: Alpha builds of the independent Ladybird browser are now downloadable for macOS and Linux.
points: Why it matters: a new browser engine is rare
Read its code to learn how browsers work

slides.title: Which story surprised you most?
slides.body: Reply 1 to 5 in the comments. Want a project built on one of these ideas?

review.text: The team was very professional, supportive, and helpful throughout the entire project. They explained everything clearly.
